async-compression-0.4.52 from crates.io, MIT OR Apache-2.0.
Upstream source commit e6376649679145e3ed26af0a7678cc885b3038f8.
Published archive SHA-256 6ad47a740fb906fffdd891e8b6d5fde2511600f7bfaebd68939fa08a14999459.

The Tokio adapter initializes up to 64 KiB of caller storage with ReadBuf
and advances it by the codec-reported byte count. Buffered reads that produce
bytes before an input error return the bytes first, then deliver the exact
error on the next nonempty read. The fork links its sibling codec and buffer
crates.
